text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - INC-6880 for service=staging-inference. symptoms=500s + elevated error-rate. affected_region=us-west-2. auto-escalation=on. details: https://pagerduty.com/INCidents/INC-6880
incident-bot: Incident created and routed to rotation "inference-night". escalation_count=1. initial_trigger=latency_threshold
alice: got the page — why is a staging service firing to night oncall? this is waking prod oncall. @ben @carla any clue?
ben: pulling PD metadata now. running: `pdctl services get --id svc-7788 --format json` to inspect tags and escalation policies
carla: i pushed a templated update earlier to tidy service tags across envs. i think i accidentally propagated the prod alert-tag into staging. :grimacing: i reverted the change in git but didn’t run apply yet
dan: checking infra pipeline history. there was a `terraform apply` at 02:12 UTC that touched pagerduty module. looks like `service_tags` got copied by the template helper — confirming diff now
erin: we need to stop pages to oncall. suggest placing maintenance on the PD service or muting the alert rule briefly while we rollback
ben: can do. creating maintenance window: `pd maintenance create --service svc-7788 --until 1733336600 --description "temp mute during rollback"`
carla: i just queued the rollback in infra repo (revert commit) and opened a PR to harden the template. will apply the rollback now
dan: terraform apply running with `-target=module.pagerduty` to limit blast radius. watching plan/apply logs
alice: monitoring customer-facing metrics: error-rate peaked ~20% of requests over ~18 minutes; most errors are 500s from runtime, some 504s from downstream. tagging impact as customer-visible but not data-loss yet
erin: notifying CS ops: @cs-ops — send short notice: "We experienced elevated 500s for inference in us-west-2 due to alert selector misconfiguration. Mitigation underway (rollback + maintenance). No PII exposure suspected."
ben: apply finished, PD shows maintenance active and new alerts suppressed. rolling back service_tags change removed the prod-alert tag from staging-inference
carla: confirming: service staging-inference tags now = ["staging", "no-prod-alert"]. alert selector no longer matches.
dan: making a quick alert rule patch to ensure selector requires env:prod explicitly before we reopen rules. will push after rollback success
alice: great. will keep watching logs and metrics. if error-rate drops below 2% sustained for 20m, we can close the PD incident. please DM me immediate pages
erin: CS msg sent and triage thread created in ops channel.
ben: creating postmortem ticket placeholder: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6880 and adding initial notes + timeline
carla: follow-ups: add CI test to prevent tag leakage, add an infrastructure lint that prevents env tags from being blanked/copied, update runbook for pagerduty selector sanity checks
incident-bot: Incident updated. mitigation=maintenance + terraform rollback. fix_in_progress=true. next_update=+10m
ben: PD incident shows alert rate dropping to baseline. i'll mark the incident resolved once metrics hold for 20m
alice: ack. thanks all for quick reaction. reminder: we need an RCA and concrete ops checklist to avoid waking night oncall for non-prod blips
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 1733333600. summary=misrouted pages due to tag/template leakage causing staging service to match prod alert selector; mitigation=PD maintenance + targeted terraform rollback. owners=[carla, ben]. postmortem=INC-6880. action_items=[add-ci-test, alert-sanity-checks, runbook-update].
